recipe_version.title: Sabich Pita with Crispy Eggplant and Tahini
recipe_version.description: Warm pocket pitas spread with hummus and stuffed with golden pan-fried eggplant, sliced hard-boiled egg, a chopped tomato-cucumber salad, dill pickles, and parsley, then drizzled with garlicky lemon tahini. Dairy-free pita contracted; amba (mango pickle sauce) optional.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp to salt the eggplant, 1/4 tsp tahini sauce, 1/4 tsp salad

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying the eggplant in 3 batches, about 2 1/2 tbsp per batch

ingredients.name: tahini
ingredients.note: well stirred. Sesame allergen, not a nut.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: juiced: about 3 tbsp. 2 tbsp for tahini, 1 tbsp for the salad.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to loosen the tahini sauce (the egg-boiling water is extra, not measured)

ingredients.name: hummus
ingredients.note: REQUIRED dairy-free: label lists no milk, yogurt, or cheese. Contains sesame (tahini).

ingredients.name: pita
ingredients.note: REQUIRED dairy-free pita: label lists no milk, whey, butter, yogurt, or other milk ingredients. Wheat allergen.

ingredients.name: flat-leaf parsley
ingredients.note: half in the salad, half to finish

ingredients.name: amba
ingredients.note: traditional tangy finish; Middle Eastern grocers or online. The dish is complete without it.

steps.title: Boil water, salt the eggplant, and prep
steps.body: Bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil for the eggs (it heats during this prep). Slice the eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds, sprinkle both sides with 1 tsp salt, and lay them on a towel-lined sheet pan for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, finely dice the tomatoes and cucumbers, chop the parsley, slice the pickles, grate the garlic, and juice the lemon. Read the pita and hummus labels: no milk, whey, butter, yogurt, or cheese. HARD CONTRACT: dairy-free pita and hummus; no feta, no yogurt sauce.

steps.title: Make the tahini sauce and salad
steps.body: In a bowl, stir the tahini with 2 tbsp lemon juice, the grated garlic, and 1/4 tsp salt. Whisk in the cold water a little at a time; it will seize and thicken, then loosen into a smooth, pourable sauce. In another bowl, toss the tomatoes, cucumbers, half the parsley, 1 tbsp lemon juice, the olive oil, and 1/4 tsp salt. Pat the eggplant slices very dry with the towel.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.body: Lower the eggs into the boiling water with a spoon and boil 10 minutes for firm but still moist yolks. Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then peel and slice into rounds. This runs alongside the eggplant.

steps.title: Pan-fry the eggplant
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch skillet over medium-high with about 2 1/2 tbsp oil until it shimmers. Fry a single layer of eggplant rounds until deep golden-brown and crisp at the edges, 3 to 4 minutes per side, and creamy all the way through. Drain on paper towels. Repeat in two more batches with the remaining oil, adjusting the heat so the slices brown without burning.

steps.title: Warm the pitas
steps.body: Wipe out the skillet and warm each pita over medium heat, about 30 seconds per side, until soft and pliable. Cut a 2-inch opening along one edge (or halve them) to make a pocket.

steps.title: Stuff and serve
steps.body: Spread 2 tbsp hummus inside each pita. Layer in the eggplant, egg slices, chopped salad, and pickles, then drizzle generously with tahini sauce and scatter with the remaining parsley. Add a spoonful of amba if you have it. Serve right away while the eggplant is still crisp. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: rimmed sheet pan and kitchen towel
2 mixing bowls plus an ice-water bowl
